scenes.title: Lutz (G.A.S.C.),Paris-Amiens, [cycliste]
scenes.description: A press photograph by Agence Rol showing a cyclist named Lutz of the G.A.S.C. during the Paris–Amiens race in 1908. It is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France (National Library of France) and is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: Hard-shell cycling helmets with ventilation slots did not exist in 1908, when cyclists wore soft cloth caps.

source.description: Référence bibliographique : Rol, 828 Appartient à l’ensemble documentaire : Pho20Rol

scenes.credit: Agence Rol. Agence photographique (commanditaire) via Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica)

scenes.title: Les forges, Bruniquel, septembre
scenes.description: This photograph, titled Les forges, Bruniquel, septembre 1889 (The forges, Bruniquel, September 1889), was taken by Eugène Trutat in September 1889 and shows forges, a bridge, a factory, a chimney, a tree, a river, banks, and vegetation at Bruniquel in Tarn-et-Garonne, France.
scenes.explanation: Photovoltaic solar panels did not exist in 1889; the first practical silicon solar cells were demonstrated in the 1950s.

source.description: Appartient à l’ensemble documentaire : RsAlis000 Appartient à l’ensemble documentaire : RsAlis014 Appartient à l’ensemble documentaire : RsAlis007

scenes.credit: Trutat, Eugène (1840-1910). Photographe via Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica)

scenes.title: Kongens gate, Moss
scenes.description: A photograph of Kongens gate in Moss, taken in 1900 and held by the National Library of Norway. The record does not name a photographer.
scenes.explanation: Plastic wheeled shopping baskets with telescoping handles did not exist in 1900; they became common only in the late 20th century.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Bryllup i Granvin
scenes.description: A wedding in Granvin, 1953, photographed by an unidentified photographer; the image is held by the National Library of Norway and is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: The wide-bladed plastic kayak paddle is a late-20th-century design that did not exist when this photograph was taken in 1953.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS, Brun, Jac via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: [Cuirassé 'le Fulminant' en mer]
scenes.description: An albumen print photograph, 9 x 12 cm, showing the warship "le Fulminant" at sea. It is dated 1890 and is held by the Bibliothèque municipale du Havre (PH BAL 093), having formerly belonged to André Baly.
scenes.explanation: The personal watercraft did not exist in 1890, so a jet ski cannot appear in this scene.
